title: Kingman crash survivor went to the back of the craft

tellings.quote: she do? His in his own words he said she went back in the craft and stayed in the back.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret US military test site in Nevada, relays what a sheriff from Kingman, Arizona told him about a craft that crashed there. According to Hall, the sheriff said a female survivor of the crash went back inside the craft and stayed in the back. If true, it would mean a living being came out of a crash in Arizona.
